The demo serves these assets locally. Vendor versions are part of the filenames for JavaScript.

- three.js r160 · MIT · https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160
- GSAP Core and ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 · GSAP Standard License · https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/
- Lenis 1.1.13 · MIT · https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/tree/v1.1.13
- Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Barlow Condensed, Manrope and Fraunces · SIL Open Font License 1.1 · https://github.com/google/fonts
- Space Grotesk · SIL Open Font License 1.1 · https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk
